Parameters

DestinationAccountId string

The payee's account at the provider.

AmountMinor long

How much, in the currency's minor units — what the payee keeps, after any fee.

CurrencyCode string

ISO 4217, in any case.

IdempotencyKey string

The caller's own key. A payee paid twice is a mistake nobody can take back, so this is the one argument that must never be reused across two different transfers.

TransferGroup string

Ties this transfer to the charges it is paid out of.
